title: HINT evalreport v0.4 keyed project verification receipt assertions
description: Closed minimized receipt assertions. No source, original-start, completion or whole-cost authority follows from validation.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of the report without this field.

work_units.description: Declared work units (project or controlled) as immutable revisions; a report may carry them without trials.

objective_ref.description: The task objective (the baseline eval), the same for the baseline and its variants. Trials of a variant pair with baseline trials only through it.

baseline_ref.description: The exact baseline eval version that this trial's eval is (equal to eval_ref) or is a variant of. Same reference scheme as eval_ref.

environment_ref.description: The task environment (image and setup) of the eval version.

result_trust.description: The eval qualification's trust (the minimum over its qualification trials): a cap, kept apart from the trial's value.

model_check.description: Whether every forwarded model request named the selected model (HINT's proxy check); only verified supports an effective launch_parameter model.

context_policy.description: The HINT context policy of the trial. enabled carries the project reference of the full identity (id, version, digest); disabled, not_applicable and unknown are different states.

declared_changes.description: Controls that this arm changes on purpose (the declared treatment); every other control must match its baseline for a comparison.

observed_config_refs.description: Project references of actual run overrides (observed, never a replacement of the immutable eval).

source_task_id.description: The task that the orchestrator declared for the agent run the eval came from: the same opaque ID as the activity correlation.task_id. Present only when the binding is unambiguous.

plan_binding.description: A client-declared association of a refactor variant with a plan and a work unit attempt (opaque references only; the server resolves the declared application).

result_trust.description: The runner's trust of this trial over the eval's required checks.

Configuration.description: The canonical effective configuration (the same form and derivations as HINT v0.2 sources[].configuration).

budget.description: The request and time limits of the run (both essential for comparison).

task_ids.description: Explicit member tasks (the same IDs as HINT activity task IDs).

result_trust.description: The minimum of the trial's value and the qualification cap.

late_tasks.description: Member tasks with activity after closure (the unit is stale for cost).

trial_ref.description: Controlled attempts: the trial (also the validation reference).

usage_provenance.description: Where the attempt's token counts come from; null counts stay null.

ordinal.description: Controlled attempts: the planned attempt slot (1..planned_attempts).

usage_normalization.description: The usage normalization of the attempt's counters (draft, C7B-E); null when unknown or mixed.

WorkUnitRevision.description: One immutable revision of a declared work unit. scope is frozen at start (scope_digest: SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 form); predecessor is the revision_digest of revision - 1 (null for revision 1); revision_digest is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of the revision without revision_digest. A declaration of work, never a confirmed effect.

environment_ref.description: Controlled units: the eval environment (image, setup, dependency locks) of the frozen version.

run_ref.description: Controlled units: the immutable run manifest, persisted before the first attempt.

Limit.description: A run limit: known with its value, unbounded when the run had explicitly no such limit, unknown otherwise. An absent value is never unbounded.

ModelState.description: The model of the run: known with its provenance (launch_intent: the constructed selection before any check — never the effective model by itself; launch_parameter: the selection that constructed the launch, enforced and checked; agent_reported: reported by the agent) or unknown. A user's declaration alone is never effective (see declared).

ResultTrust.description: How far a verdict is independent of the candidate code, from the runner's statement only. same_process: the checks ran inside the process of the code under test (not independent of the candidate; descriptive evidence only); process_separated: an evaluator that never loaded candidate code gave the verdict; unknown: no statement (legacy, including former Harbor jobs) or anything incomplete. Never raised; required from report_version 0.2.1.
